title: AI・DXを使う仕事の人
subject: AI・DXを使う仕事の人
subject_en: A neutral Japanese man office worker in his early 30s, short black hair, gray jacket, white shirt, dark slacks, simple minimal flat style, accompanied by abstract sparkle icon and tablet, no robot face copying existing characters, no real person or existing character. Always the same face, hairstyle and outfit.
